title: Rank of an input and work-tape reading
statement: For a machine reading an input symbol that is either a Boolean value or blank, together with Boolean-or-blank symbols on each of its $k$ work tapes, the read rank is the element of ${0,\ldots,3^{k+1}-1}$ obtained by encoding the input symbol in base $3$ as the leading digit and the work-tape symbols as the remaining rank.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $k$ of work tapes
A Boolean-or-blank symbol on each of the $k$ work tapes
caveat: The snippet uses inputRank and workRank without providing their definitions, so the exact digit encoding cannot be stated from this payload alone.
